decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt multi-sample step-up in all axes near index 485–490, likely a permanent jump or rapid transient; (2) a complex interval ~605–620 with strong cross-axis coupling—steep N rise, large E oscillation, and sharp U drop—suggesting superposed motion components or ambiguous return behavior. Other intervals show smoother trends or noise.

regions.observation: N/E/U show a multi-sample step-up around index 485–490 (within window [365,544]), with N rising from ~1.5 to ~18, E shifting from ~-1.5 to ~-1.7, and U dropping sharply from ~-0.5 to ~-5; the change is abrupt over 2–3 samples and not clearly reversed in this window.

From ~index 605 to 620, N increases steadily (~71→75), E shows oscillatory behavior with large swings (e.g., -0.7→2.8→-0.7), and U drops sharply (~-5.7→-7.9) then recovers partially; ambiguous superposition of trend, possible opposing returns, and a multi-sample offset near 615–620.
